newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE's Etisalat announces flat first half dividend.
newsitem.headline: UAE's Etisalat announces flat first half dividend.

text.p: The United Arab Emirates telecommunications firm Etisalat said on Tuesday it would distribute a 25 dirham cash dividend for the first half of 1997.
The dividend is the same as that paid for the first half of 1996 and as that distributed for the second half of last year.
Etisalat shares, which dominate the UAE's unofficial stock market, would be suspended from July 28 to August 13, during which time the dividends would be paid, the company said.
The UAE government owns 60 percent of Etisalat shares, with private investors holding the rest.
